subject: Exec approval: long-term price hold with uplift-pausing mechanism for Tide Labs
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Anna Park <anna@tidelabs.com>, Simon O'Reilly <simon@procureco.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval request — long-term price hold + 'pause uplift' clause (Tide Labs)

Team,

Quick summary: Tide Labs (strategic healthcare analytics) is asking for a 3-year commitment with a non-standard term we haven't accepted before — a price hold for years 1–2 and a capped uplift in year 3, plus a "paused uplift" trigger that suspends the year-3 uplift if their rolling 3-month token usage drops more than 25% vs. baseline. Procurement insists the pause is necessary given unpredictable integration timing.

Why this matters:
- ACV if closed: ~$1.1M ARR (year 1 run-rate).
- Strategic value: reference customer in healthcare, potentially opens 2 enterprise accounts.
- Timing: integration window extends into year 2; they want protection against forced uplifts during rollout dips.

What I'm asking for:
1) Exec sign-off to accept a 3-year term with: price hold years 1–2 (no uplift), year-3 uplift capped at 8% (annualized), and a "paused uplift" clause that suspends the year-3 uplift once if (and only if) 3-month rolling usage declines >25% from the agreed baseline, with a maximum of two pause events across the 3-year term.
2) Requirement: an escrow deposit equal to 3 months of committed spend to offset short-term revenue risk.
3) Legal & Finance to authorize delegated redlines (I will attach a draft term sheet).

Attachments: TideLabs_term_sheet_v3.pdf (term sheet w/ redlines), usage_forecast.xlsx (account forecast + rationale).

Requested next steps:
- Marissa: deal-desk margin impact and delegated approval threshold?
- Jordan: if we need alternate routing (Dedicated/Private) to meet SLAs, flag here.
- Laura: request for exec approval or conditions for approval.

I recommend approval with guardrails, but will escalate if you want different limits. We need a final position by Friday so procurement can circulate the DocuSign.

Thanks — Avery

--
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:08:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — long-term price hold + 'pause uplift' clause (Tide Labs)

Avery — thanks for the clear ask and attachments, helpful. A few quick items before I can recommend to Finance/Legal: 

1) Please add a 24-month forward-looking token forecast by month (break out baseline, expected ramp, and downside scenario that matches the proposed 25% drop trigger). The attached usage_forecast.xlsx is a start but I need month-level detail and the margin impact by quarter.
2) What is the expected blended unit economics vs our standard term? Provide % margin delta and ARR at-risk if the pause is exercised.
3) Legal: can you confirm the escrow mechanism? Who holds the escrow (custodian) and is it refundable pro rata if the pause is activated?
4) Delegation: per deal desk thresholds, anything above a 7% expected margin erosion requires VP sign-off. If the uplift cap is 8% we need to ensure the net still meets threshold.

If you can have those numbers by EOD tomorrow I will run this to Finance and loop Legal for redlines. If Finance asks for a smaller uplift cap (6%) would that be acceptable to the customer?

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 16:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — long-term price hold + 'pause uplift' clause (Tide Labs)

Thanks for raising, Avery. I reviewed the term sheet and the strategic asks. I will provisionally approve the structure with the following firm conditions — Legal and Finance must sign off on the final language: 

1) Price hold: acceptable for years 1–2 (no uplift).
2) Year-3 uplift: cap at 8% maximum. If Finance requests a lower cap for margin preservation, Marissa will propose alternate caps (6% or 7%) with the trade-offs.
3) Paused uplift trigger: acceptable under constraints — pause may be invoked up to two times during the 3-year term, each pause limited to a single billing cycle quarter (90 days), and pause is only available if the rolling 3-month usage drops >25% vs baseline AND the customer is actively engaged in the approved integration plan (documented milestones required).
4) Escrow: require customer to fund an escrow equal to 3 months of committed spend; escrow custodian to be a neutral third-party (we'll use the standard escrow agent listed in the Legal playbook). Escrow released pro rata as the term progresses or if pause is asserted we draw up to the escrow amount to cover shortfall per the draw schedule.
5) Minimum commitment protection: if the customer cancels or materially reduces committed consumption outside the pause conditions, Redwood may invoke shortfall invoicing for the remainder of the committed year.

Next steps: Marissa, run margin impact and acceptability thresholds to Finance and Legal. Jordan, ensure there's an SLA addendum if they're pinning year-1 latency to Dedicated capacity — if so we need a separate capacity commit. Avery, update the term sheet to incorporate the milestone language and resend to Anna for confirmation.

If Legal and Finance are clean, I authorize Marissa to finalize with CFO sign-off. This is approved in principle — get me any redline that materially changes the escrow or pause mechanics.

Laura

--

Subject: Re: Exec approval request — long-term price hold + 'pause uplift' clause (Tide Labs)

Hi Avery + Redwood team — thanks for working through this so quickly. Tide Labs is comfortable with the conditional framework Laura outlined. A few final items from procurement: 

- We will fund the 3-month escrow on signature (confirming custodian details in the DocuSign).
- We request the pause mechanism be permitted once per year (up to two times, per your note), and tied to a specified milestone chart — we'll populate the milestone sheet in the next 48 hours.
- We prefer the uplift cap to be 6% if possible, but understand your internal constraints; happy to trade on term or payment cadence.

Please send the final DocuSign link for signature and we will aim to execute this week.

Anna
